text:
mara: Heads up — we observed p95 jump on router v3.2.1 in eu-west around 22:40. Planning a swingback to v3.2.0 for a short quiet window (23:00-23:15) to validate. Can ops + releases confirm readiness?

alex: seeing same p95 spike in traces, looks correlated with longer KV-cache misses. Agree with short swingback.

jamie: prepared rollback steps in runbook. checklist: drain new lanes, switch router weights, monitor p95 & 5xx, validate cookie/session continuity.

mara: thanks. tagging @sre_bot and @deploy-bot to run the traffic shift and keep an eye on latency artifacts.

sre_bot: @mara received. I'll coordinate lane drains and watch the health endpoints. ETA to start at 23:01 (give 1m buffer).

deploy-bot: Scheduled action: traffic-shift --from v3.2.1 --to v3.2.0 --strategy staged --steps 10,20,40,80,100 --probe p95<250ms --timeout 3m. Waiting for manual confirm to run.

alex: quick precheck: all blue nodes report healthy, no high CPU. No config changes since last deploy. Approving staged shift. :thumbsup:

jamie: small reminder — session cookie name was renamed in 3.2.1 but we had compatibility fallbacks. Watch for cookie churn in logs. I pushed a short query to infra dashboards.

mara: confirmed. manual-confirm from eng-releases on my mark. We'll abort if p95 > 300ms or 5xx rate > 0.5%.

mara: MARK — go ahead @deploy-bot

deploy-bot: Action started: traffic-shift (id=ts-5999-01). Step 1 -> 10% to v3.2.0. Monitoring probes.

sre_bot: step1 green. p95 dropped 30ms on shifted lanes. no 5xx. proceeding.

deploy-bot: Step 2 -> 20% -> 30% cum. Running probes.

alex: seeing small improvement, KV hit rate slightly better. continue.

deploy-bot: Step 3 -> 40% -> 70% cum. Probe ok.

jamie: logs show expected cookie header mix, fallback path exercised correctly.

sre_bot: Step 4 -> 80% -> 90% cum. All checks pass.

deploy-bot: Final step -> 100% traffic on v3.2.0. Completed at 5999001296.

mara: nice. keeping in quiet window until 23:15. monitoring for at least 15m.

alex: agree, baseline p95 back to normal. I'll run a small synthetic load test in next 5m.

sre_bot: snapshotting metrics and saving to /dashboards/releases/snapshots/5999001234.json

mara: filing a short postmortem note: root cause likely regression in cache invalidation path introduced in 3.2.1. tagging eng-ml and runtime for follow-up.

jamie: adding release note entry: "3.2.1: reverted KV cache optimization pending deeper validation — users served by v3.2.0 during rollback." Will sync with product.

mara: big thank you to ops and deploy bot. If anyone sees a late regress, call the channel and we'll re-open. :heart:

deploy-bot: Action summary: traffic-shift id=ts-5999-01, status=completed, duration=2m, aborts=0, steps=[10,20,40,80,100]. Logs: https://internal.deploy/logs/ts-5999-01

sre_bot: leaving watch until 23:30 then demobilizing.

mara: closing thread for now — follow-up tasks assigned in backlog (ENG-4472 run deeper cache replay tests).
